schedule.rule: Move all 14 days together. No backfilling missed dates with mass posting; times are hypotheses pending account Insights.

brandRules.name: BAZAAR
brandRules.logoRule: Original asset in Latin, unchanged proportions. No translated or regenerated wordmark.
brandRules.typeRule: Keep the currently accepted clean dense sans-serif letterforms. Normalize headline weight and scale; do not introduce another font family. Inspect at equal canvas width and in the whole grid.
brandRules.fontFamilyStatus: Unknown in the original raster. Canva's automatic DM Sans reconstruction was visually different and is excluded.
brandRules.screenshotPlacement: Separate carousel slides, separate Story frames and separate Reel scenes. No interface screenshot over an illustrated or photographic card.
brandRules.screenshotTypography: Preserve real application typography. Do not retype, regenerate or retouch interface labels, statuses or values. Marketing headline consistency applies to illustrated cards.

typography.sizeRule: Inherited from the same verified native master. Never change per-card heading size.

primary: Cost per qualified lead after an approved paid test
secondary: Video retention and saves as content diagnostics
qualification: Decision maker or person involved in choosing the system
measurement.sourcePolicy: A Direct keyword is not proof of a paid source. Use Meta referral/ad ID when available, record self-report separately, and keep unknown attribution unknown.
measurement.paidTest: Prepare distinct checkout and stock-control concepts first. Do not launch, reserve spend or set a positive budget without owner approval.
measurement.iteration: Review qualified conversations, demonstrations and business registrations after week one. Change the second-week mix using evidence; do not infer a winner from followers or one day of low-volume data.

«Бизнесмен»: до 5 магазинов, 5 000 товаров и 10 активных пользователей. Добавляются аналитика, импорт и экспорт, инвентаризация, цены по магазинам, комплекты, партии со сроками годности и закрытие периода.

«Монополист»: до 15 магазинов, 20 000 товаров и 20 активных пользователей. Возможности «Бизнесмен», комплаенс, инструменты поддержки и модуль ККМ при отдельной настройке. Подключение оборудования и внешних сервисов не происходит автоматически.
